signal_definition: ttH + tH hadronic-preselection MC (TI and NTI), SM-normalized MC weight
background_definition: resonant ggH TI MC in 125+/-2 GeV window, plus NTI observed-data sidebands (105-120, 130-160) scaled by SF1*SF2
excluded_from_training: nominal TI observed data in 125+/-2 GeV window (blinded)
